en: Philemon 1

p.src: 1  Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
u.src: 1  Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

en: 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 2  to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

en: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
u.src: 2  to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

p.src: 3  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
u.src: 3  Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

p.src: 4  I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

en: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
u.src: 4  I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

p.src: 5  hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

en: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
u.src: 5  hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

zh: 1:5 或譯：因聽說你向主耶穌和眾聖徒有愛心有信心

p.src: 6  that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

en: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
u.src: 6  that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

p.src: 7  For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

en: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
u.src: 7  For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

p.src: 8  Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

en: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
u.src: 8  Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

p.src: 9  yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

en: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
u.src: 9  yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

p.src: 10  I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

en: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
u.src: 10  I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

en: 1:10 Onesimus means “useful”.

p.src: 11  who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

en: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
u.src: 11  who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

p.src: 12  I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

en: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
u.src: 12  I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

p.src: 13  whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

en: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
u.src: 13  whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

p.src: 14  But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

en: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
u.src: 14  But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

p.src: 15  For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

en: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
u.src: 15  For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

p.src: 16  no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

en: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
u.src: 16  no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

p.src: 17  If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

en: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
u.src: 17  If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

p.src: 18  But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

en: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
u.src: 18  But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

p.src: 19  I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

en: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
u.src: 19  I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

p.src: 20  Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

en: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
u.src: 20  Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

p.src: 21  Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

en: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
u.src: 21  Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

p.src: 22  Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

en: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
u.src: 22  Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

p.src: 23  Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
u.src: 23  Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

p.src: 24  as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

en: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
u.src: 24  as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

p.src: 25  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
u.src: 25  The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
